name: Steep
summary: A rating of one to five tea cups that a kettle pours along the row, with steam and a sugar plop
about: A feedback card for a tea house where the stars are five porcelain cups. Hover to preview, pick a score and the kettle tips and glides along the row filling each cup, the tea deepens in colour with a better score, steam curls up and a sugar cube plops into the last cup. Lower the score and the extra cups drain; then pick what stood out, add a note and send it to get a thank-you cup.
how: Hover the cups to preview, then click or tap one to rate from 1 to 5 cups
With the keyboard, Tab to the cups and use the arrow keys; the kettle follows your pick
Toggle the chips for what stood out and add an optional note of up to 140 characters
Press Send rating: the kettle whistles, then a thank-you cup appears; Rate again starts over
